title: Boxing Custom Errors
goal: Implement `std::error::Error` on a custom struct so it can be converted into Box<dyn Error>.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Error Handling

hints: Box<dyn Error> requires the trait `std::error::Error` to be implemented.
Implement the Error trait for ErrorA and propagate with the try operator.
explanation: A type must explicitly implement `std::error::Error` to be boxed as `Box<dyn Error>`. Without `impl Error for ErrorA {}`, the compiler emits `E0277`. Once implemented, `Err(ErrorA)?` automatically converts `ErrorA` into `Box<dyn Error>` using `From`.
